{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of 'responded' by site
response_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Identify the site with the highest response rate
highest_response_site = response_by_site.idxmax()
highest_response_rate = response_by_site.max()

# Print results
highest_response_site, highest_response_rate"}
